description: This file defines a React functional component 'SessionsByOrganization' that renders a responsive bar chart visualizing session counts grouped by organization name. It imports React and components from 'recharts', and includes internal functions for label truncation and a custom tooltip.

methods.name: truncateLabel
methods.description: Truncates a label string to a maximum length, appending an ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A React component that renders a custom tooltip for the bar chart, showing session count details.
